Happy 16th Birthday, my cute sister! ❤️

Chahe hum kitni bhi masti karein, nok-jhok ho ya ek dusre ko tease karein, tum hamesha mere liye bahut special rahogi.

Life mein tumhare saamne bahut saare naye dreams aur opportunities aayenge. Hamesha khud par believe karna, apni smile ko kabhi lose mat karna, aur jo dil se chahti ho uske liye mehnat karna. ✨

May your 16th year bring you happiness, confidence, beautiful memories and lots of reasons to smile. Aur haan… aaj birthday hai, toh smile karna compulsory hai! 😄💖

— KRISHNA ❤️
